admission: Primary frozen grid and positive confirmation lower paired bound, followed by every OOF fold positive and pooled lower bound positive. Component effects may be smaller than the final submission threshold.
candidate_set: Each admitted fixed-weight component blend plus the equal mean of all admitted blends. No numeric weight optimization. Select highest eligible pooled OOF AUC in this predeclared set.
submission_gate: Every fold positive, pooled conditional95% lower bound>0, and pooled delta>=.0002 relative to v4. This tightens the earlier .00015 effect requirement to preserve the final two submission slots.
limitation: Features and training settings were selected on reused development splits; conditional intervals do not include selection uncertainty.
